findings.claim: The patch skips the only postgres integration test of storage-server startup and /metrics instead of fixing it. This removes coverage for a supported backend and hides the startup failure that eager Init exposes.

verifier.reason: TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer in pkg/server/module_server_test.go:35-38 skips postgres with a TODO comment instead of fixing the test (where addStorageServerToConfig at pkg/server/module_server_test.go:75-79 hardcodes db_host to localhost, unlike MySQL). Because NewResourceServer now eagerly calls s.Init(ctx) at pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:258-262 during storage-server startup, skipping postgres removes CI coverage for a supported backend and masks the startup failure exposed by eager Init.

findings.claim: The function-wide cacheMu lock was removed from BuildIndex, so concurrent callers (e.g. a Search request and handleEvent via getOrCreateIndex) can build the same key at once. The last writer wins, one built index goes untracked or its documents are lost, and file-backed indexes can be created concurrently in the same directory.

verifier.reason: In pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:72-141, BuildIndex only locks b.cacheMu around the unconditional b.cache[key] = idx write at lines 137-139, and getOrCreateIndex in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:287-307 (called concurrently by Search at lines 147 and 158 and handleEvent at line 237) has no per-key synchronization. Concurrent builds for the same key overwrite each other in b.cache—leaving one index untracked and potentially losing updates written by handleEvent at pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:257—and can invoke bleve.New(dir, mapper) concurrently on the same directory at pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:96-98 when size > b.opts.FileThreshold.

findings.claim: Eager Init runs inside the wire graph for every Grafana process on context.Background() with no deadline. A DB or search failure or hang now blocks Grafana startup.

verifier.reason: In pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:229-262, NewResourceServer creates a deadline-free context from context.Background() and eagerly runs s.Init(ctx), which executes DB initialization/migrations/ping (pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:80-99), search index building (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:167-212), and watcher queries, returning any error. Because unified.ProvideUnifiedStorageClient (pkg/storage/unified/client.go:101 -> pkg/storage/unified/sql/server.go:77) is unconditionally wired into server.Initialize via pkg/server/wire.go:169, pkg/registry/backgroundsvcs/background_services.go:69, and pkg/services/apiserver/service.go:142 (including for the default legacy storage_type), a DB or search error or hang fails or blocks Grafana startup.

findings.claim: There is an untracked TODO about the RV short-circuit optimization.

verifier.reason: pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:100 has an untracked TODO comment ('// TODO, check last RV so we can see if the numbers have changed') without an issue reference for the RV short-circuit optimization described on pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go:79-80, leaving the resourceVersion parameter unused in BuildIndex.

findings.claim: When Init fails, NewResourceServer returns (nil, err) without calling cancel() or lifecycle.Stop. This leaks the context, and if search.init succeeded before initWatcher failed, it also leaks the search watch goroutine and its sql poller.

verifier.reason: In pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:229-262, NewResourceServer creates a cancelable context and calls s.Init(ctx), returning (nil, err) on failure without calling cancel() or s.lifecycle.Stop. If s.search.init(ctx) (server.go:305) succeeds before s.initWatcher() (server.go:310) fails, the watch goroutine in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:203-213 and the SQL poller goroutine in pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:566-578 (stopped only via backend.Stop) remain leaked.
